evidence: Directly modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to support running txindex on pruned nodes.
rationale: Enables txindex on pruned nodes, resolving multiple long-standing feature requests (issues #10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). By storing block hashes rather than file offsets, nodes can maintain transaction index coverage without storing hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history on disk.
